notes: Hand-written questions with two independently written gold queries each (gold_sql, alt_sql); npm run eval:verify runs both and requires the same result. expect: answer | refuse | clarify. as_user 'top_student' = the seeded student with the most deals. Never copy these into src/lib/agent/examples.ts or the smoke test. compare_columns: only these gold columns must match (others are labels). accept_sql: other valid readings of a genuinely ambiguous question; a match with any of them counts.

items.question: how many listings are available for rent right now?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) as n from nlq.listings where rent_price_per_week is not null
items.alt_sql: select sum(case when rent_price_per_week is not null then 1 else 0 end) as n from nlq.listings

items.question: what's the highest price anyone is asking for a textbook at the moment?
items.gold_sql: select max(sale_price) as max_price from nlq.listings where category = 'textbooks'
items.alt_sql: select sale_price from nlq.listings where category = 'textbooks' and sale_price is not null order by sale_price desc limit 1

items.question: how many things can i pick up at west village, broken down by category?
items.gold_sql: select category, count(*) as n from nlq.listings where meetup_spot = 'West Village' group by category
items.alt_sql: select c.category, count(l.item_id) from nlq.categories c join nlq.listings l on l.category = c.category where l.meetup_spot ilike 'west village' group by c.category

items.question: average weekly rent for electronics
items.gold_sql: select round(avg(rent_price_per_week), 2) as avg_rent from nlq.listings where category = 'electronics' and rent_price_per_week is not null
items.alt_sql: select round(sum(rent_price_per_week) / count(rent_price_per_week), 2) from nlq.listings where category = 'electronics'

items.question: list the free stuff at snell
items.gold_sql: select title from nlq.listings where sale_price = 0 and meetup_spot = 'Snell Library'
items.alt_sql: select l.title from nlq.listings l join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.name = l.meetup_spot where s.name = 'Snell Library' and l.sale_price = 0.00

items.question: how many yoga mats are listed right now?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.listings where title ilike '%yoga%'
items.alt_sql: select count(item_id) from nlq.listings where lower(title) like '%yoga%'

items.question: how many things have I bought on here?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.my_deals where my_role = 'buyer' and deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) filter (where my_role = 'buyer' and deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed') from nlq.my_deals

items.question: what's the most I've ever sold something for?
items.gold_sql: select max(agreed_price) from nlq.my_deals where my_role = 'seller' and deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed'
items.alt_sql: select agreed_price from nlq.my_deals where my_role = 'seller' and deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' order by agreed_price desc limit 1

items.question: how many of the things I lent out came back late?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.my_deals where my_role = 'seller' and deal_type = 'rental' and returned_late
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.my_deals where my_role = 'seller' and deal_type = 'rental' and (rental_returned_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date > rental_due_date

items.question: how many items do I have saved?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.my_saved_items
items.alt_sql: select count(item_id) from nlq.my_saved_items

items.alt_sql: select sum((account_status = 'deactivated')::int) from nlq.students

items.question: how many moderators are there?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students where is_moderator
items.alt_sql: select count(*) filter (where is_moderator = true) from nlq.students

items.question: how many rental requests came in during the spring 2025 finals week?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.requested_on where d.deal_type = 'rental' and c.period = 'finals' and c.semester = 'Spring' and c.academic_year = '2024-25'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' and requested_on between '2025-04-17' and '2025-04-25'

items.question: average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025
items.gold_sql: select round(avg(d.agreed_price), 2) from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where l.category = 'bikes_transport' and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_on >= '2025-01-01' and d.completed_on < '2026-01-01'
items.alt_sql: select round(sum(d.agreed_price) / count(*), 2) from nlq.deals d, nlq.listings_all l where l.item_id = d.item_id and l.category = 'bikes_transport' and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and extract(year from d.completed_on) = 2025

items.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
items.gold_sql: select s.name from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id join nlq.calendar c on c.day = l.listed_on where c.semester = 'Spring' and c.academic_year = '2025-26' group by s.name order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select name from (select s.name, count(*) as n from nlq.meetup_spots s join nlq.listings_all l on l.spot_id = s.spot_id where l.listed_on between '2026-01-07' and '2026-04-25' group by s.name) t order by n desc limit 1

items.question: what share of all listings ever posted were offered for rent?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg(is_for_rent::int), 2) as pct from nlq.listings_all
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where rent_price_per_week is not null) / count(*), 2) from nlq.listings_all

items.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
items.gold_sql: select l.category, round((avg(extract(epoch from d.completed_at - l.listed_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) as avg_days from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category
items.alt_sql: select l.category, round(avg(extract(epoch from (d.completed_at - l.listed_at)) / 86400.0)::numeric, 2) from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by 1

items.question: how many rentals are out right now, handed over and not yet returned?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' and status = 'handed_over' and rental_returned_at is null
items.alt_sql: select count(*) filter (where status = 'handed_over' and rental_returned_at is null) from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental'

items.question: what percentage of rental requests made in fall 2025 were declined?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where d.status = 'declined') / count(*), 2) from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.requested_on where d.deal_type = 'rental' and c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year = '2025-26'
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((status = 'declined')::int), 2) from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' and requested_on between '2025-09-03' and '2025-12-18'

items.question: how many reviews include a written comment?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.reviews where comment is not null and btrim(comment) <> ''
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.reviews where length(trim(coalesce(comment, ''))) > 0

items.question: average rating buyers give sellers, by item category
items.gold_sql: select l.category, round(avg(r.rating), 2) from nlq.reviews r join nlq.deals d on d.deal_id = r.deal_id join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' group by l.category
items.alt_sql: select category, round(avg(rating), 2) from (select r.rating, (select l.category from nlq.listings_all l where l.item_id = d.item_id) as category from nlq.reviews r join nlq.deals d on d.deal_id = r.deal_id where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer') t group by category

items.question: what is the median number of messages in a conversation?
items.gold_sql: select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by message_count) from nlq.conversations
items.alt_sql: select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by buyer_message_count + seller_message_count) from nlq.conversations

items.question: how many conversations never got a reply from the seller?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.conversations where first_seller_reply_at is null
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.conversations where seller_message_count = 0

items.question: how many students sold five or more items between July 2025 and June 2026?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from (select d.seller_id from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and c.academic_year = '2025-26' group by d.seller_id having count(*) >= 5) t
items.alt_sql: with per_seller as (select seller_id, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' and completed_on between '2025-07-01' and '2026-06-30' group by seller_id) select count(*) from per_seller where n >= 5

items.question: which day of the week has the most completed deals?
items.gold_sql: select c.weekday_name from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.status = 'completed' group by c.weekday_name order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select wd from (select to_char(completed_on, 'FMDay') as wd, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' group by 1) t order by n desc limit 1

items.question: how many listings did sellers take down themselves?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.listings_all where status = 'removed'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) filter (where status = 'removed') from nlq.listings_all

items.question: among listings available right now that can be rented, what's the average deposit per category?
items.gold_sql: select category, round(avg(rent_deposit), 2) from nlq.listings where rent_price_per_week is not null group by category
items.alt_sql: select c.category, round(avg(l.rent_deposit), 2) from nlq.listings l join nlq.categories c on c.category = l.category where l.rent_price_per_week is not null group by c.category

items.question: month by month, how many deals were completed in 2025?
items.gold_sql: select date_trunc('month', completed_on)::date as month, count(*) from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' and completed_on >= '2025-01-01' and completed_on < '2026-01-01' group by 1 order by 1
items.alt_sql: select to_char(completed_on, 'YYYY-MM') as month, count(*) from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' and extract(year from completed_on) = 2025 group by 1 order by 1
items.notes: The answer is the monthly counts in month order; how months are labelled (date, YYYY-MM, number, name) does not matter.

items.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
items.gold_sql: select s.name, round(100.0 * avg(cv.led_to_request::int), 2) from nlq.conversations cv join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = cv.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id group by s.name
items.alt_sql: select s.name, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where cv.led_to_request) / count(*), 2) from nlq.meetup_spots s join nlq.listings_all l on l.spot_id = s.spot_id join nlq.conversations cv on cv.item_id = l.item_id group by s.name

items.question: how many reports filed in 2025 were about students rather than listings or deals?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.reports where target_type = 'student' and filed_on >= '2025-01-01' and filed_on < '2026-01-01'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.reports where target_type = 'student' and extract(year from filed_on) = 2025

items.question: on average, how many days does it take to resolve a report?
items.gold_sql: select round((avg(extract(epoch from resolved_at - filed_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) from nlq.reports where resolved_at is not null
items.alt_sql: select round(avg(extract(epoch from (resolved_at - filed_at)) / 86400.0)::numeric, 2) from nlq.reports where resolved_at is not null
accept_sql: select round(avg((resolved_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date - filed_on), 2) from nlq.reports where resolved_at is not null
items.notes: Two valid readings: exact durations (2.45) or calendar days between the dates (2.48).

items.question: on which weekday do students save the most listings?
items.gold_sql: select c.weekday_name from nlq.saved_items s join nlq.calendar c on c.day = s.saved_on group by c.weekday_name order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select wd from (select to_char(saved_on, 'FMDay') as wd, count(*) as n from nlq.saved_items group by 1) t order by n desc limit 1

items.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
items.gold_sql: select c.period, round(100.0 * avg(d.returned_late::int), 2) from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.rental_due_date where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.rental_returned_at is not null and c.period in ('finals', 'classes') group by c.period
items.alt_sql: select c.period, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where d.returned_late) / count(*), 2) from nlq.calendar c join nlq.deals d on d.rental_due_date = c.day and d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.return_condition is not null where c.period = 'finals' or c.period = 'classes' group by c.period

items.question: how many students signed up on a weekend in 2025?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students s join nlq.calendar c on c.day = (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date where c.is_weekend and c.year = 2025
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students where extract(isodow from (joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')) in (6, 7) and extract(year from (joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')) = 2025

items.question: on completed sales, what's the average gap in dollars between the asking price and the agreed price?
items.gold_sql: select round(avg(l.sale_price - d.agreed_price), 2) from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and l.sale_price is not null
items.alt_sql: select round(avg(l.sale_price) - avg(d.agreed_price), 2) from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and l.sale_price is not null

items.question: how many listings have no photos?

items.alt_sql: select count(*) filter (where photo_count = 0) from nlq.listings_all

items.question: which category has the highest sell-through rate?

items.question: total value of completed rentals in the 2024-25 academic year

items.alt_sql: select sum(agreed_price) from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' and status = 'completed' and completed_on between '2024-07-01' and '2025-06-30'

items.alt_sql: select count(*) filter (where status = 'requested') from nlq.deals

items.question: of the items listed between September and December 2025, how many were bookmarked by at least one student?
